LESSON: HEAT TRANSFER

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Force and Energy
Topic 3.3: Heat transfer

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Heat transfer
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How is heat transferred through materials in nature?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. demonstrate the modes of heat transfer in nature
2. classify conductors of heat into good or poor conductors
3. explain the uses of heat transfer in day-to-day life

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Heat transfer

Teach
• Observe Heat transfer in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Heat transfer (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Heat transfer.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Heat transfer.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Heat transfer.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• demonstrate the modes of heat transfer in nature
• classify conductors of heat into good or poor conductors
• explain the uses of heat transfer in day-to-day life

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Heat transfer.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Heat transfer: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How is heat transferred through materials in nature?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• demonstrate the modes of heat transfer in nature
• classify conductors of heat into good or poor conductors
• explain the uses of heat transfer in day-to-day life
